mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 4%, it signals strong demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as companies ramp up production to meet demand.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY change exceeds 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals an improving labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher borrowing costs weigh on corporate profits.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY change < -10% and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: HOUST YoY change < -10% and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a favorable environment for corporate profits that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA and FEDFUNDS < 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is rising by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage growth and boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rising > 200k per month
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rising > 200k per month but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it signals a high-inflation environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as the Fed is likely to continue tightening monetary policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.
